title.zh: Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Hoodi Fork Over EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 Risks
title.en: Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Hoodi Fork Over EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 Risks

current_state.zh: Ethereum's planned Glamsterdam fork on the Hoodi testnet was delayed after ChainSecurity found that gas-accounting changes in EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 could break contracts assuming gas usage only decreases or alter failed sub-call behavior, with 13 real-world cases under review and the spec possibly needing revision.
